title: Organised crime arrests as police investigate A66 crash that killed two officers
description: Nine men and three women are arrested as police investigate the lead-up to the crash that killed seven people.

title: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
description: At 03:30 BST on Saturday, two police officers were killed when a Volkswagen Passat collided with their marked car on the A66 motorway.

title: Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
description: It comes after Moscow warned of "consequences" over the reported use of British drones by Ukraine.
